Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring aversive agents in antifreeze products.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to placing averse agents in antifreeze; and addinga new section to chapter 70.106 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.106 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any antifreeze product containing by weight ten percent or moreethylene glycol and manufactured in this state on or after July 1,2008, or sold in this state on or after July 1, 2009, must also containan aversive agent, approved by the director, in a concentrationsufficient to render that antifreeze product unpalatable to humans andanimals. (2) If the director finds or has probable cause to believe that anyantifreeze product being sold in this state fails to comply withsubsection (1) of this section, the director is authorized to orderthat product's removal from retail shelf space.
